project.name: osgi/runtime/jagged-wrap
project.description: jagged (1.0.0) — the pure-Java age encryption library — wrapped as a first-class OSGi bundle, the single age-in-OSGi carrier that backs the age CellarCipher (the multi-recipient seal of the seed-broker cellar). jagged ships PLAIN jars with NO Bundle-SymbolicName, so it needs a wrap; but UNLIKE fabric8 it is maximally clean — it has NO external runtime dependencies on JDK 21+ (X25519 via JEP 324, ChaCha20-Poly1305 via JEP 329 are JDK-built-in JCA), no split-package, and no ServiceLoader across bundles, so NO Aries SpiFly and no embedded tail. The wrap is the jgiven-wrap shape: put jagged-x25519 (which pulls jagged-framework/api/bech32 via jagged-bom) on the bnd classpath, export com.exceptionfactory.jagged.* — bnd copies jagged's own bytecode into this one bundle — and Import-Package only the JDK (java.*, javax.crypto.*), resolved from the framework/boot. Only the x25519 recipient type is carried (asymmetric seal to age recipients); scrypt/ssh are not pulled.
